property_summary: For any successful fallback call that sends exactly 10 ether and occurs at a strictly greater block.timestamp than the stored pastBlockTime, the reference contract updates its public pastBlockTime to the current block.timestamp; the mutant that omits the assignment can leave pastBlockTime unchanged for some inputs (so after the call pastBlockTime differs).
change_summary: Delete the assignment to pastBlockTime so the stored value does not update after fallback calls.
